children: Tether has been allocating up to 15% of operating profits to Bitcoin since May 2023, building a treasury estimated at 83k–100k BTC (worth over $8B), targeting ~10% BTC allocation.
BTCUSD spot demand stayed weak while derivatives activity climbed; aggregate futures open interest rose to about $27.53 billion, indicating futures-driven momentum outpacing spot participation.
Bitcoin (BTCUSD) saw heavy miner selling in August as MPI hit 2.8 to fund AI capex; after big AI buys, MPI dropped to -1.2 in September 2026 and miner outflows eased.
BTCUSD: van de Poppe warns a break below $78,000 could trigger a deeper pullback toward $74,000. Arthur Hayes says BTC may exceed its prior ATH by year-end, with uneven gains.
August on‑chain: 1–2 year coin share fell ~6.2%, >10 year holdings down ~0.1%. Fidelity noted rising long‑term supply links to lower float and reduced BTCUSD spot CFD volatility.
German party's platform urges wide deregulation of Bitcoin, wallets and trading, backs Bitcoin as a strategic asset and rejects a digital euro—potentially affecting BTCUSD regulatory backdrop.
A 2010-era wallet moved 600 BTC (to two Native SegWit addresses) after ~16 years; transfer valued at ~$47.7M. No confirmed onward movement to centralized exchange wallets for BTCUSD spot CFD.
Vitalik Buterin said AI likely won’t break Bitcoin’s long-term security and that prices need social consensus to collapse; no market data or BTCUSD trading signals were provided.
